```sql
    title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),

    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
        CHECK (
            length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 30
            AND name NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*'
        )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_tags (
    note_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tag_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (note_id, tag_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (note_id) REFERENCES notes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tags(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
```

```python
import os
import re
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

app = FastAPI()

TAG_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9]{1,30}$")


class NoteCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str
    body: str = ""
    tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def get_db_path() -> str:
    return os.getenv("NOTES_DB", "notes.db")


def get_connection() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(get_db_path())
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


def normalize_tags(tags: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    normalized: List[str] = []
    seen = set()

    for raw in tags:
        tag = raw.lower()
        if not TAG_RE.fullmatch(tag):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Invalid tag format")
        if tag not in seen:
            seen.add(tag)
            normalized.append(tag)

    return normalized


def current_utc_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def fetch_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int):
    note_row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes WHERE id = ?",
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if note_row is None:
        return None

    tag_rows = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT t.name
        FROM tags t
        JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.tag_id = t.id
        WHERE nt.note_id = ?
        ORDER BY t.name
        """,
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchall()

    return {
        "id": note_row["id"],
        "title": note_row["title"],
        "body": note_row["body"],
        "created_at": note_row["created_at"],
        "tags": [r["name"] for r in tag_rows],
    }


@app.on_event("startup")
def startup() -> None:
    schema_path = Path(__file__).with_name("schema.sql")
    schema_sql = schema_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        conn.executescript(schema_sql)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.post("/notes", status_code=201)
def create_note(payload: NoteCreate):
    if len(payload.title) < 1 or len(payload.title) > 120:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Title must be 1 to 120 characters")

    tags = normalize_tags(payload.tags)
    created_at = current_utc_iso()

    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO notes (title, body, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (payload.title, payload.body, created_at),
        )
        note_id = cur.lastrowid

        for tag in tags:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO tags (name) VALUES (?) ON CONFLICT(name) DO NOTHING",
                (tag,),
            )
            tag_row = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name = ?", (tag,)).fetchone()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO note_tags (note_id, tag_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (note_id, tag_row["id"]),
            )

        conn.commit()
        return fetch_note(conn, note_id)
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.get("/notes/{note_id}")
def get_note(note_id: int):
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        note = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
        if note is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Note not found")
        return note
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.get("/notes")
def list_notes(tag: Optional[str] = Query(default=None)):
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        params = []
        if tag is None:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id FROM notes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC"
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            normalized_tag = tag.lower()
            if not TAG_RE.fullmatch(normalized_tag):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Invalid tag format")
            rows = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT n.id
                FROM notes n
                JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.note_id = n.id
                JOIN tags t ON t.id = nt.tag_id
                WHERE t.name = ?
                ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
                """,
                (normalized_tag,),
            ).fetchall()

        return [fetch_note(conn, row["id"]) for row in rows]
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.delete("/notes/{note_id}", status_code=204)
def delete_note(note_id: int):
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,))
        conn.commit()
        if cur.rowcount == 0:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Note not found")
        return Response(status_code=204)
    finally:
        conn.close()
```

```python
import importlib

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    db_path = tmp_path / "notes_test.db"
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOTES_DB", str(db_path))

    import app as app_module

    app_module = importlib.reload(app_module)

    with TestClient(app_module.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def test_create_and_get_note(client):
    create_resp = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={
            "title": "First note",
            "body": "Hello",
            "tags": ["Work", "todo"],
        },
    )
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    created = create_resp.json()

    assert created["id"] > 0
    assert created["title"] == "First note"
    assert created["body"] == "Hello"
    assert created["created_at"].endswith("Z")
    assert sorted(created["tags"]) == ["todo", "work"]

    get_resp = client.get(f"/notes/{created['id']}")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    fetched = get_resp.json()
    assert fetched == created


def test_list_notes_and_filter_by_tag(client):
    n1 = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "Older", "body": "one", "tags": ["work"]},
    )
    assert n1.status_code == 201

    n2 = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "Newer", "body": "two", "tags": ["personal"]},
    )
    assert n2.status_code == 201

    all_resp = client.get("/notes")
    assert all_resp.status_code == 200
    all_notes = all_resp.json()
    assert len(all_notes) == 2
    assert all_notes[0]["title"] == "Newer"
    assert all_notes[1]["title"] == "Older"

    filtered = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "WORK"})
    assert filtered.status_code == 200
    filtered_notes = filtered.json()
    assert len(filtered_notes) == 1
    assert filtered_notes[0]["title"] == "Older"


def test_delete_and_404(client):
    created = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "To delete", "body": "", "tags": []},
    )
    assert created.status_code == 201
    note_id = created.json()["id"]

    delete_resp = client.delete(f"/notes/{note_id}")
    assert delete_resp.status_code == 204
    assert delete_resp.text == ""

    get_after_delete = client.get(f"/notes/{note_id}")
    assert get_after_delete.status_code == 404

    delete_missing = client.delete("/notes/999999")
    assert delete_missing.status_code == 404


def test_get_missing_returns_404(client):
    resp = client.get("/notes/123456")
    assert resp.status_code == 404


def test_invalid_title_returns_422(client):
    resp_empty = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "", "body": "", "tags": []})
    assert resp_empty.status_code == 422

    resp_long = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "x" * 121, "body": "", "tags": []},
    )
    assert resp_long.status_code == 422


def test_invalid_tag_returns_422(client):
    resp = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "Bad tag", "body": "", "tags": ["not-valid!"]},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 422

    resp_query = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "bad-tag"})
    assert resp_query.status_code == 422
```
